search_window.basis: Previous Food Line watch heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger verified and read back: completed 2026-11-02 22:51:03.617 PST (2026-11-03T06:51:03.617Z). Discovery targeted recent 1-2 days for reporting/index lag; only newly verified qualifying disruptions since that heartbeat were eligible.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary, bounded high-value miss-class recall, not the authoritative national Food Line production collector.
target_classes: Community's only/sole/last/full-service grocery lost or closed due to fire/disaster
Emergency food distribution canceled/suspended due to weather/flood/fire/outage/damage
Abrupt food pantry/food-bank closure or major service reduction
New official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance benefit or access interruption
bounded_query_context: "only grocery store" closes fire Nov 2 2026 community
"last grocery store" closed November 2026 rural town
"food bank" closed storm facility damage November 2 2026
"food pantry" power outage service cancelled November 2026
SNAP EBT outage state benefits inaccessible November 2 2026
WIC benefits system outage November 2 2026 agency
site:gov SNAP benefits interruption delayed November 2 2026 emergency
coverage_notes.observation: All twelve targeted searches returned usable discovery results. No candidate independently verified as a new, eligible food-access disruption after 22:51:03 PST Nov 2. Search results were predominantly historical/irrelevant; the short-window retrieval did not demonstrate a new official benefit interruption or provider closure.

excluded_examples.reason: Eastport, Maine sole grocer closure was reported September 3, well before the current post-heartbeat interval.
Spencer, NY only-store fire/closure published September, not a new event.
October 29 hurricane recovery roundup, before the watch interval and no new food-distribution cancellation confirmed.
Federal SNAP interruption from previous year.

duplicate_screen.method: Retrieved prior heartbeat directly from ops/watch-ledger; excluded cases predating the completion and nonqualifying categories.

coverage_notes.limitations: Bounded discovery cannot establish zero nationwide incidents. Very fresh local provider bulletins may not yet be indexed, and retrieved same-day search precision was low. No claim is made that production collection has or has not handled a candidate.
coverage_notes.production_authority: No approval, publication, schedule change, disabling action, or change to primary production collection.
coverage_notes.scheduled_for_note: Set to the invocation timestamp supplied by the run context because the nominal hourly recurrence time had not yet arrived at execution start.
